item.title: 20-foot-high hillside collapses at Ampang’s Bukit Teratai Park
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: A 20-foot-high hillside was reported to have collapsed at Taman Bukit Teratai Ampang here this morning, believed to have been caused by an underground pipe leak. Selangor Fire and Rescue Department (JBPM) Operations Division Assistant Director Ahmad Mukhlis Mukhtar said his department received an emergency call regarding the incident at 9.19 am. item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Salaam Cola, a premium alternative carbonated beverage brand with a strong social mission, has officially entered the Malaysian market through its local distributor, Dunya Damai Sdn Bhd.
